messages:
Evan Brooks: Heads up - SummitHealth evaluating a locked-EU POC. Requirements: tenant pinned to eu-central-1, BYO KMS, explicit sub-processor PDF, and VPC peering. Can we collect owners?
Tara Lin: I can own the runbook / network steps. Need infra ACLs and cert exchange checklist.
Corey Patel: Short infra notes: 1) eu-central-1 Dedicated available for short-term demo; 2) hosted with tenant_pin + failover: none_unless_approved is possible but ops attestation required; 3) metrics telemetry can be scoped eu-only during POC.
Marta Ruiz: Legal asks for a signed subproc export (not just link) and BYO KMS flow doc. We'll need a DPA addendum for the POC window.
Evan Brooks: Pricing ask: 5-day POC. What's delta hosted vs dedicated? Any peering/setup fees?
Corey Patel: Ballpark: Dedicated demo slab ~€4k for 1 week (min commit), hosted pinned trial ~€900 + KMS ops fees ~€300. Peering/setup flat fee ~€250 if we run the exchange.
Tara Lin: Runbook TO-DOs: 1) CIDR/CNAME handshake, 2) cert PEM exchange, 3) KMS ARN verification (sample encrypt/decrypt), 4) smoke test endpoints + traceroute to confirm EU egress.
Marta Ruiz: I'll draft the POC addendum: no-cross-border routing clause, subproc list attached, BYO KMS envelope assurance.
ops-bot: Ticket created RDW-1301: "SummitHealth EU POC - VPC peering + BYO KMS + subproc attestation" assigned to @corey.p
Evan Brooks: Can we get first-pass deliverables by Tue EOD?
Corey Patel: Yes - I'll upload runbook + subproc PDF within 24h.
Tara Lin: I'll post a minimal test matrix in the runbook: (1) locality check, (2) KMS envelope round-trip, (3) p95 latency target <250ms for 256 tokens, (4) audit log export available to customer.
Marta Ruiz: ETA addendum draft 36h.
Evan Brooks: Thanks team. Keep thread for audit. :thumbsup:
